body_lead: The Union Budget presented by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Saturday prioritised the integration of modern technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), into India’s education sector, said Maharashtra’s Higher and Technical Education Minister Chandrakant Patil. “This budget brings opportunities for all sectors of society, from farmers to students, with a strong focus on digital education. The allocation of AI resources and support for higher education is a significant step towards making India a global economic powerhouse,” said Patil.
